item.title: Meta agrees to teen safety overhaul and $18bn payment, shares rise
item.summary: Meta Platforms has struck an agreement with a group of 52 US attorneys general to introduce sweeping new safety measures for teenagers on Facebook and Instagram, alongside a payment of around $18bn.
